dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible across the dorsal and right-lateral surfaces are multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. The perimeters consist of high-intensity (lighter) pixel bands surrounding lower-intensity (darker) centers. The edge geometry is characterized by serrated, non-uniform boundaries with a distinct gradient transition towards the interior of each ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is observed. These clusters are primarily situated in the interstitial regions between the larger annuli, appearing as small, asymmetrical bright spots without internal gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent annuli on the upper-mid dorsal region form an acute scalene triangle. An additional geometric relationship is visible on the right lateral flank, where the centroids of four adjacent ring structures form an irregular quadrilateral.
